milestone: Our top priority is locking in the facility we submitted an LOI on. That depends on Consumers Energy quoting and installing the electrical service our equipment needs. Once the facility is secured, we'll need to raise additional capital to leverage our $250k Michigan Circular Economy Grant and start buying additional equipment, materials, and supplies. At the same time, we're building out our CRM, ERP, and SOPs so that once the new process is running we can smoothly take orders and start producing 4x8 & 5x10 panels.
